صَيَّاحٌ A clamorous man: and anything noisy, or sounding much. (The Lexicons passim.) ―
-b2- الصَّيَّاحُ is another name for العَوَّآءُ [i. e. The constellation Bootes]. (Kzw.) ―
-b3- And (tropical:) A certain perfume, or fragrant substance: (K, TA:) or a wash for the head, (A, K, *) consisting of خَلُوق [q. v.], and the like. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
